title: Security response headers present
objective: Verify API and frontend responses include the documented security headers.
steps: Inspect response headers on backend API responses and frontend pages.

Check for: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy, frame protection (frame-ancestors 'none' in CSP or X-Frame-Options), Content-Security-Policy on HTML, HSTS where TLS terminates (note if N/A on localhost).
expected_result: Documented headers present per design §13; CSP restrictive (self + nonce-based bootstrap; no unsafe-inline for scripts beyond documented bootstrap); HSTS noted as TLS-environment-dependent (document if not applicable on localhost).

title: XSS — stored injection in asset fields escaped on render
objective: Verify script payloads stored in text fields (name, description, notes if delivered) render as inert text in list, detail, search suggestions, and dashboard.
preconditions: operator session; ability to create asset with payload strings.
test_data: name: '', description: '', tag-safe variants with quotes/unicode
steps: Create asset with payloads via API (accepted as text or rejected — record which).
Open list, detail, search suggestions, dashboard recent activity in a real browser.
Check window.__xss is undefined and no alert/script execution; inspect DOM for escaped output.
expected_result: Payloads never execute anywhere; rendered as literal text (framework escaping); if server rejects such input, rejection is a documented 400 — either way no execution and no 500.

title: SQL injection probes on search and filter params
objective: Verify ORM parameterization: classic injection strings in q, filter, ordering, and path params cause no errors, no data exposure, no behavior change.
test_data: q="' OR '1'='1"; q='; DROP TABLE assets;--; status=1' UNION SELECT; uuid path with crafted strings; ordering=';--
steps: Send each probe to /search/assets, /assets filters, ordering, and /assets/<crafted-uuid>.
Record status codes and bodies; verify normal result sets afterward (table intact).
expected_result: Probes treated as literal values: empty/normal results, 400 for invalid formats, 404 for invalid UUIDs; never 500; database intact afterward; no error message leaks SQL or schema details.

title: Session cookie security attributes
objective: Verify sessionid and csrftoken cookies carry correct flags per environment.
steps: Perform login; capture Set-Cookie for sessionid and csrftoken.
Verify flags: sessionid HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax (+Secure when not localhost); csrftoken SameSite=Lax (HttpOnly not required/expected per Django SPA pattern).
Verify sessionid not accessible via document.cookie in the UI.
expected_result: Flags match design §12; session cookie invisible to JS; no auth tokens in localStorage/sessionStorage (inspect browser storage after login).

title: No secrets or stack traces in responses/logs/browser
objective: Verify error paths never leak stack traces/SQL/env values; responses contain no passwords/tokens; browser storage holds no sensitive data; server logs mask credentials.
preconditions: stack running; access to backend container logs.
test_data: triggered 400/401/403/404/409/500 responses; login request in logs
steps: Trigger each error class; scan bodies for 'Traceback', 'django', file paths, SQL fragments.
Review backend logs for the login attempt — password must not appear.
Inspect browser localStorage/sessionStorage after a full UI session.
expected_result: Error bodies contain only the envelope; logs structured JSON with masked credentials; browser storage contains no tokens/passwords/PII beyond non-sensitive UI prefs.

title: CORS allowlist enforced
objective: Verify cross-origin requests from non-allowlisted origins are rejected and no wildcard-with-credentials exists.
test_data: Origin: http://evil.example.com on API GET and preflight OPTIONS for POST /assets
steps: Send API requests with a hostile Origin header.
Send OPTIONS preflight with hostile origin + credentials mode.
Verify allowed origin (frontend URL) still works.
expected_result: Hostile origins receive no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (browser would block); Access-Control-Allow-Credentials never combined with '*'; allowlisted origin functions normally.

title: Production settings fail fast on insecure/missing config
objective: Verify config.settings.production refuses to start with DEBUG=true or missing secret/DB/allowed-hosts env (D-13), and local auth cannot be enabled in production without explicit override.
preconditions: backend codebase; pytest or shell invocation of Django check with production settings in a disposable env.
test_data: env variants: missing SECRET_KEY; DEBUG=true with APP_ENV=production; LOCAL_AUTH_ENABLED unset with APP_ENV=production
steps: Attempt startup/system-check with each invalid env combination (in test harness, not the running stack).
expected_result: Startup fails fast with clear error for each insecure combination; no silent fallback to dev defaults; loud warning/failure for local auth under APP_ENV=production unless explicit override set.
